title: Did the 1962 Alcatraz Escapees Actually Survive the Freezing Bay?
description:
On June 12, 1962, guards at Alcatraz made a chilling discovery: the inmates sleeping in their beds were actually dummy heads made of soap, toilet paper, and real human hair. Frank Morris and the Anglin brothers had vanished without a trace.

The trio spent months widening concrete vents with stolen spoons and built a makeshift raft from over 50 raincoats to cross the freezing, fast-moving waters of San Francisco Bay. The FBI eventually closed the case in 1979, ruling them presumed drowned, but no bodies were ever recovered.

Decades later, a mysterious letter arrived claiming to be from John Anglin, offering proof of survival in exchange for medical leniency. To this day, no one can confirm if they drowned or actually pulled off the greatest prison escape in history.
